## Amgi with on-device RWKV scheduling

The first build of Amgi that schedules reviews with RWKV on the iPhone, using the same Rust engine as the RWKV desktop fork ([Saamoz/anki](https://github.com/Saamoz/anki)).

- **Settings › RWKV Scheduler › Turn On RWKV** downloads the Small models (2.7 MB, checked by SHA-256) and schedules every preset with RWKV-Curve. The model weights are not included in this IPA.
- **Deck Options:** choose FSRS, RWKV-Curve or RWKV-Instant per preset.
- RWKV learns from your whole review history once, then keeps up with every answer and with reviews synced from other devices, and saves its state on the device.
- **Calibration:** predicted vs. actual recall, in Settings.
- Fixes preset saves dropping settings the app does not show (FSRS-7, RWKV) and switching the load balancer off.
